one_liner: Amazon’s official REST APIs for sellers/vendors to manage selling operations programmatically.
access_notes: Professional selling account primary user creates a Developer Profile and registers an app to obtain client_id/client_secret; production/public use is subject to Amazon’s app review and role approvals.
mcp_notes: Official Amazon Selling Partner Connector MCP server is hosted by Amazon at https://sellingpartner-ai.amazon.com/mcp (bundled via the amzn/selling-partner-agentic-toolkit).
blocker_notes: Self-serve dev credentials are available, but moving to production requires Amazon’s app review (including restricted role/DPP approval for PII), a Professional selling account, and meeting Appstore listing/onboarding requirements; SQS/EventBridge notifications setup is also required for many use cases.

evidence.quote: You must have a Professional selling account and be the primary account user to create an SP-API developer profile.
authorization flow based on Login with Amazon (LWA), which is Amazon's implementation of OAuth 2.0.
Restricted roles: For roles that involve PII, there is a three-stage review process
You can receive these notifications through Amazon Simple Queue Service or Amazon EventBridge.
This repository contains Swagger models for developers to use to create software that calls Selling Partner APIs.

_trail.quote: "In accordance with the Solution Provider Agreement, public developers must list their app in the Amazon Selling Partner Appstore."
"The bundled `.mcp.json` registers the Amazon Selling Partner Connector (MCP server) at `https://sellingpartner-ai.amazon.com/mcp`."

_reconciled.reason: Aligned MCP notes to name the official vendor-hosted MCP server URL per the evidence; kept app_review-dependent buildability/blocker as-is.
